CustomField.description: Which borrower owes this condition. Left blank the condition is shared: it appears in every borrower's portal and is satisfied for all of them by the first upload. Restrict, so a borrower row carrying assignments cannot be deleted out from under it and silently turn private documents into shared ones.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank if this item belongs to the whole file. Assigning it to a borrower means only that borrower sees it in their portal.
